title: Empowering Social Work Alumni through Local Development and Employment

contacts.name: Geta, Mitrea
contacts.affiliation: Stefan cel Mare University of Suceava

descriptions: This is a sociological study conducted among six generations (2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2022) from social work bachelor degree graduates from Stefan cel Mare University of Suceava, Romania regarding their employment stage on the labor market.
